source_basis: NCCP00908 v1b (https://healthservice.hse.ie/documents/6856/908_NCCP_SACT_Regimen_Serplulimab.pdf), pages6–8, and EMA Hetronifly overview (https://www.ema.europa.eu/en/medicines/human/EPAR/hetronifly), checked2026-10-26. Current EMA SmPC updated8October2026 was downloaded and sections4.2,4.4,4.8,5.1 reconciled (https://www.ema.europa.eu/en/documents/product-information/hetronifly-epar-product-information_en.pdf). These qualitative risks do not import another checkpoint inhibitor’s frequencies.

risks.label: Immune inflammation of healthy organs
risks.detail: Lungs, bowel, liver, kidneys, skin, pancreas, heart, nervous system (including myasthenia and encephalitis), eyes and blood cells can be affected. Some reactions are severe or life-threatening and can occur after treatment ends.

risks.label: Hormone-gland inflammation or diabetes
risks.detail: Thyroid, pituitary or adrenal problems and type1diabetes can cause marked weakness, dizziness, headache, thirst or other symptoms. Some effects need long-term hormone replacement; severe endocrine crises need urgent care.

risks.label: Infusion reaction
risks.detail: Reactions can include flushing, itching, breathing changes or feeling faint. Tell the nurse immediately; serious reactions require stopping serplulimab.

risks.label: Severe skin reaction
risks.detail: Blistering or peeling skin and sores around the mouth or eyes need urgent assessment; some severe skin syndromes require permanent treatment discontinuation.
